question: What act of satisfaction follows, and by which alternative form may it be done?
premises: The sequence continues after the prior offering.
The satisfaction may be done by this form of the Lady of Tripura or alternatively.
inference: Afterward, one should satisfy the maidens, using this form of Tripureśī or an alternative.
uncertainties: The exact alternative indicated by athavā is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Then, having satisfied the maidens, one may do so by this form of the Lady of Tripura or by another.
